notes.title: Options added in the 1.2 version !
notes.notes:
Thanks to my first ever bad review, I was made aware of motion sickness issues and general life confort tweaks that could be added to the game.

I've since added an in game Options menu, both in the main menu and in game (in the pause screen). Please let me know any new bugs that might arise in the comments !

Have a good one !

Elie
